newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia bond spreads stable within dlr bloc.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia bond spreads stable within dlr bloc.

text.p: Australian bonds held relatively steady against other dollar bloc bonds with yield spreads generally showing little noteable movement.

The local market remains fairly well-contained in a range ahead of next week's Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) board meeting where there remains a strong possibility of a 50 basis point easing in official interest rates being endorsed.

The major indicator ahead for global markets generally is Friday's release of the October U.S. non-farm payrolls report, given that markets were widely taken off-guard by a surprise 40,000 fall in the September figures.
The Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread continued to see-saw around the 100 basis points level.
The only notable move was against the short-end of the New Zealand curve which came under pressure after N.Z. 90-day bank bills broke through 9.0 percent.
